findings.finding: Corsicana is the swing item at this print. In August Riot disclosed a non-binding LOI with one undisclosed tenant for the whole Corsicana site (up to 756 MW of IT capacity; the CEO said it could exceed $1B a year in rent). Management named converting it into a lease as a 2026 priority. No executed lease had been disclosed by 2026-11-03: EDGAR shows no 8-K since 10-14, and that 8-K was a custody agreement. The 8:00 ET 4 Nov call is the first earnings call since the LOI. An executed lease would be the largest positive available; a slipping LOI is a modest negative.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The last big lease announcement came with the Q2 print. On 10 Aug 2026 the 191 MW / $9.1B 20-year lease ran +25% after hours, and the stock closed the next session only +4.33% at $20.24 (https://theblock.co/news/business/2026-08-10-riot-platforms-ai-deal-anthropic-411358). The AMD expansion option in the Q1 print went +7% (https://crypto.news/riot-q1-results-show-bitcoin-pressure-and-ai-data-center-growth/). Lease news pays a fraction of its after-hours pop by the close.
findings.why_not_priced: Whether the LOI converts by this print is unknown and binary. If the market expected an executed lease, the stock would not be down 38% since 30 Sep with downside skew bid, and the street's 2029-2030 revenue estimates would not have been cut 16-27% (TIKR 10-26). Size is about 20% x +8 close-to-close for a signing, less about 80% x -1 for no signing.
findings.independence: TIKR 10-26 names a Corsicana update as one of the two things 4 Nov has to show (https://www.tikr.com/blog/riot-platforms-fell-38-since-september-30-and-the-streets-mean-target-now-sits-138-above-it-heres-what-november-4-has-to-show). It does not confirm a signing; none was found anywhere.

findings.finding: The refinancing is overdue. The roughly $180M term loan on AMD's first 25 MW, which management expected to close before 30 Sep, had not been announced by 26 Oct, and no 8-K item 1.01/2.03 has been filed since 14 Aug. The $573M Morgan Stanley delayed-draw bridge for the 191 MW AI-lab build matures 31 Dec 2026, and the refinancing waits on an investment-grade backstop the company has not described. What the money buys: the build for a signed 20-year, $9.1B lease (reported to be Anthropic) plus the AMD capacity, and the CFO says the bridge is fully covered by the tenant. Riot prepaid its $200M Coinbase facility on 21 Sep, releasing 5,821 pledged BTC. A $500M ATM has existed since about March 2026.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: There is no prior print where financing was the headline. The stock fell about 8% in the first week of October and 11.5% on 16 Oct, and the cited causes were sector credit and rate worries plus the bridge maturity, not a company release (TIKR 10-08 and 10-20).
findings.why_not_priced: The slip is public and the drawdown has partly priced it. The call resolves it in one direction or the other. A signed AMD term loan or a named IG backstop would remove the one execution fear analysts keep citing; another 'in the coming months' would confirm it. If the market had priced a clean resolution, the stock would not sit at the street's lowest target ($13) with puts bid.
findings.independence: Same facts from another source: https://www.merlintrader.com/?p=20473 (updated 2026-11-02), and EDGAR's filing list (https://www.sec.gov/cgi-bin/browse-edgar?action=getcompany&CIK=0001167419&type=8-K) shows no financing 8-K after 2026-08-14. Both describe one fact set; count it once.

findings.finding: Bitcoin rose about 42.7% in Q3 2026, from $58,527 at 30 Jun (Riot's own Q2 mark) to about $83,460 at 30 Sep. The September figure is implied by Strategy's $70.82B carrying value on 848,517 BTC. On Riot's 11,380 BTC at 30 Jun, less any coins sold to prepay Coinbase, that is roughly $200-285M of fair-value gain, about $0.55-0.76 a share. GAAP EPS should print well above the -$0.27 to -$0.33 consensus. This is a remeasurement with no path to guidance.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Headline EPS has not driven this stock. Q3 2025 net income was $104.5M (a beat) and the stock fell 6.21%. Q1 2026 EPS was -$1.44 against -$0.33 and the stock rose about 7% (https://www.metatrader.com/de/news/1578919-riots-q1-earnings-miss-estimates-revenues-up-yy-shares-rise). Q2 2026 EPS of -$0.68 missed and the stock closed +4.33% the next session.
findings.why_not_priced: Everyone knows the BTC price, so the mark itself is priced. What may not be priced is the headline: if the consensus EPS excludes the mark, screens and algos will show a large beat at 07:xx ET. The name's history says that is noise by the close.
findings.independence: The Q3 BTC gain of +42.71% is from COINOTAG via https://pro.edgex.exchange/en-US/news/article/bitcoin-q3-2026-best-quarter-since-2017 (2026-10-01). Riot's 30 Jun mark of $58,527 and 11,380 BTC are from its Q2 exhibit, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001167419/000110465926093406/riot-20260810xex99d2.htm.

findings.finding: A peer read-through landed after Riot last spoke. Cipher Digital reported Q3 2026 on 2 Nov. It amended Barber Lake into a second 10-year term directly with a leading AI lab, adding about $5.2B of rent, and sold $850M of 0.000% converts due 2032. Two weeks after the CoreWeave bond scare (yields briefly above 15% on 14 Oct) and Cantor's cuts to seven AI-data-center names (16 Oct), the convertible market was still open to a Texas ex-miner AI landlord, and AI-lab demand was still being contracted. That bears directly on Riot's refinancing question and its Corsicana LOI.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Riot trades with this group: on 16 Oct RIOT fell 11.48% alongside HUT -10.96% and WULF -7.45% on the Cantor note (TIKR 10-20). CIFR's own reaction to its 2 Nov print was not found.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: RIOT is +2.1% over five days. This is a proxy, not a Riot document. Riot has not confirmed its own access to the market, and its backstop is a bank IG structure, not a convertible.
findings.independence: Proxy only. Sector context for the October sell-off is in https://www.tikr.com/blog/riot-platforms-stock-fell-11-on-october-16-after-cantor-cut-its-target-heres-where-the-stock-could-go (2026-10-20).

findings.finding: Positioning into the print: down 37.8% from 30 Sep to 23 Oct ($12.53) with no company-specific negative release (TIKR says Riot made no announcement explaining the drop), about 14.8% of float short at 2.8 days to cover, and a +19 vol-point put skew. A print that is merely not worse than feared meets a short base and a crowded put position.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Four of seven verified prior reactions were 6-18% in absolute size. Lease news on 10 Aug faded from +25% after hours to +4.33%, so oversold or euphoric starts have not carried.
findings.why_not_priced: This goes against the skew, so the size is small. The case that the option market is wrong rests on causes: the drop came from sector credit and rate fear, not from Riot's own numbers. If the market expected a damaging print, the 2027-2028 revenue estimates would have fallen with the price, and they fell only 1.2-1.6% while the stock fell 38%.

findings.finding: Q3 is the first full quarter of rent on AMD's 25 MW, which was delivered in May. Q2 operating lease revenue was $4.9M at 84% margin, and the AMD contract implies about $8M a quarter for 25 MW. Delivery of the next 10 MW is guided for November 2026.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Data-center revenue debuted at $33.2M in Q1 2026 and the stock rose about 7%. That move was mixed with the news of AMD's expansion option.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced. It falls inside what the company already disclosed. TIKR flags that a full quarter barely above $4.9M would undermine the rent ramp, so only a shortfall would move the stock.
findings.independence: Uses the same Q2 exhibit as the BTC finding (for Riot's starting position) and as TIKR 10-26, which is the source for the $4.9M test.

outside_window.finding: The $573M Morgan Stanley bridge matures 2026-12-31. If it is not refinanced by then, that is a real negative, but the date is after the window. Inside the window only the update on the call counts (filed under findings).
The next 10 MW of AMD capacity is due in November 2026 and the remaining 15 MW in May 2027. Ready-for-service will most likely be confirmed after 2026-11-04.

baseline_tension: The findings lean slightly positive against a +19 vol-point put skew and a -27% 20-day run-up. The lean rests on two-sided catalysts and on positioning, not on a decisive unpriced number, so p_up stays at 52.
